first_reply: The repo. https://github.com/elder-plinius/T3MP3ST Read the maturity table before you point it at anything you don't own or have explicit permission to test.
why_this_one: Before this, Pliny mostly shipped jailbreaks and leaked prompts. T3MP3ST is a swing at something more structural, complete with a script that grades its own claims instead of just asserting them.

linkedin_caption:
T3MP3ST turns your coding agent into a security scanner. Pliny built it so recon, scanning, and eventually exploitation all run through the AI agent already on your machine. No new API key. No second bill.

Here is the part I like. The README does not pretend all eight operators work yet. Recon is proven, tested against real challenges. The other four are marked experimental, plainly. There is even a script that re-derives every headline claim from the raw committed data before you have to trust it.

Three days old and already past 500 stars. Worth a look if you spend any time in offensive security tooling.
